disposition_reason: Data report of cadmium in US foods collected 1979-1980: per-food-group geometric means (Table 2) and carrots by production place (Table 3); per-item values are not printed.

study.design: historical market-basket style food analysis (1979-1980) with intake estimate from the USDA Total Diet Study
study.origin: carrots from nine production places in the US and Canada
study.market: supermarkets in Houston, Boston and Los Angeles; some restaurants
study.method: oven-dried 105 °C, HNO3 hot-plate ashing, graphite furnace AAS (Perkin-Elmer 603) with deuterium background correction
study.lod_text: 0.5 ng in 100 mg dried food or 1.0 mL of liquid
study.qa: NBS CRMs 1567 rice flour, 1570 spinach, 1577 bovine liver; spike recoveries 108% and 105%; CV 18% for ten analyses

findings.group: supermarkets (and some restaurants) in Houston, Boston and Los Angeles, 1979-1980
findings.notes: geometric mean over the food items of the group listed in Table 1; item counts, GD and wet/dry basis of the GM not printed; non-detects set to one-third of the detection limit; used with consumption in g/day so likely wet weight
